sql: SELECT log_events.event_id AS event_id, strftime(log_events.ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS ts, log_events.component AS component, log_events.level AS level, log_events.node AS node, log_events.alert_label AS alert_label, log_events.request_id AS request_id, log_events.host AS host, log_events.process_id AS process_id, log_events.client_ip AS client_ip, log_events.thread AS thread, log_events.block_id AS block_id, NULL::VARCHAR AS trace_id, NULL::VARCHAR AS span_id, NULL::INTEGER AS severity_number, log_events.pattern_id AS pattern_id, left(log_events.message, 400) AS message, length(log_events.message) > 400 AS message_truncated, log_events.dataset, strftime(log_events.ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS ts_exact FROM log_events WHERE log_events.event_id = $1

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE log_events.ts >= $1::TIMESTAMPTZ - $3::INTERVAL AND (log_events.ts < $1::TIMESTAMPTZ OR (log_events.ts = $1::TIMESTAMPTZ AND log_events.event_id < $2))) AS before, count(*) FILTER (WHERE log_events.ts <= $1::TIMESTAMPTZ + $3::INTERVAL AND (log_events.ts > $1::TIMESTAMPTZ OR (log_events.ts = $1::TIMESTAMPTZ AND log_events.event_id > $2))) AS after FROM log_events WHERE log_events.dataset = $4 AND log_events.request_id = $5 AND ((log_events.ts >= $1::TIMESTAMPTZ - $3::INTERVAL AND (log_events.ts < $1::TIMESTAMPTZ OR (log_events.ts = $1::TIMESTAMPTZ AND log_events.event_id < $2))) OR (log_events.ts <= $1::TIMESTAMPTZ + $3::INTERVAL AND (log_events.ts > $1::TIMESTAMPTZ OR (log_events.ts = $1::TIMESTAMPTZ AND log_events.event_id > $2))))

SELECT log_events.event_id AS event_id, strftime(log_events.ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS ts, log_events.component AS component, log_events.level AS level, log_events.node AS node, log_events.alert_label AS alert_label, log_events.request_id AS request_id, log_events.host AS host, log_events.process_id AS process_id, log_events.client_ip AS client_ip, log_events.thread AS thread, log_events.block_id AS block_id, NULL::VARCHAR AS trace_id, NULL::VARCHAR AS span_id, NULL::INTEGER AS severity_number, log_events.pattern_id AS pattern_id, left(log_events.message, 400) AS message, length(log_events.message) > 400 AS message_truncated, (epoch_us(log_events.ts) - epoch_us($1::TIMESTAMPTZ))::DOUBLE / 1000 AS offset_ms FROM log_events WHERE log_events.dataset = $4 AND log_events.request_id = $5 AND log_events.ts >= $1::TIMESTAMPTZ - $3::INTERVAL AND (log_events.ts < $1::TIMESTAMPTZ OR (log_events.ts = $1::TIMESTAMPTZ AND log_events.event_id < $2)) ORDER BY log_events.ts DESC, log_events.event_id DESC LIMIT $6

SELECT log_events.event_id AS event_id, strftime(log_events.ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS ts, log_events.component AS component, log_events.level AS level, log_events.node AS node, log_events.alert_label AS alert_label, log_events.request_id AS request_id, log_events.host AS host, log_events.process_id AS process_id, log_events.client_ip AS client_ip, log_events.thread AS thread, log_events.block_id AS block_id, NULL::VARCHAR AS trace_id, NULL::VARCHAR AS span_id, NULL::INTEGER AS severity_number, log_events.pattern_id AS pattern_id, left(log_events.message, 400) AS message, length(log_events.message) > 400 AS message_truncated, (epoch_us(log_events.ts) - epoch_us($1::TIMESTAMPTZ))::DOUBLE / 1000 AS offset_ms FROM log_events WHERE log_events.dataset = $4 AND log_events.request_id = $5 AND log_events.ts <= $1::TIMESTAMPTZ + $3::INTERVAL AND (log_events.ts > $1::TIMESTAMPTZ OR (log_events.ts = $1::TIMESTAMPTZ AND log_events.event_id > $2)) ORDER BY log_events.ts, log_events.event_id LIMIT $6
